description: Actual Rust/Wasm scenes rendered by CanvasKit CPU raster and separate TypeScript compiler fixtures. No GPU or physical latency claims.

cases.expected: Cached and fresh complete CanvasKit paths paint the same actual portable scene; obsolete paths retire.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/skia-raster.test.ts:actual CanvasKit raster draws actual portable scene and matches uncached complete paths

cases.expected: Bounded staged path rejection preserves prior raster pixels and disposes temporary wrappers.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/skia-raster.test.ts:actual CanvasKit capacity rejection retains prior pixels and disposes bounded staged paths

cases.expected: Small geometry at signed billion-unit origins produces identical raster pixels under fractional transforms.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/skia-precision.test.ts:actual CanvasKit preserves small portable geometry at signed billion-unit origins with fractional transforms

cases.expected: Complete paged translucent geometry fills once and selected preview replaces the original.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/skia-precision.test.ts:actual CanvasKit fills complete paged translucent portable geometry once and suppresses preview originals

cases.expected: Actual huge-span portable geometry renders shared prepared pixels across the visible viewport.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/skia-precision.test.ts:actual portable huge-span scene renders shared prepared pixels across the viewport

cases.expected: CanvasKit and WebGPU signatures accept valid fixtures and reject both incorrect argument types.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/skia-types.test.ts:CanvasKit published API and built-in WebGPU remain checked with legacy globals deduplicated

cases.expected: Shared prepared signed crossings match independent local references under fractional/asymmetric backing; giant enclosing/grazing interiors and empty output render correctly.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/skia-prepared.test.ts:actual shared prepared signed crossing paths match local references with asymmetric fractional backing and one alpha fill
node:apps/web/tests/skia-prepared.test.ts:actual prepared enclosing and grazing giant curves preserve filled interiors
node:apps/web/tests/skia-prepared.test.ts:actual prepared empty pixel path releases its lease and paints no false coverage

cases.expected: Complete multi-page preview paths reuse only matching viewport, transform and actual backing dimensions.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/skia-prepared.test.ts:actual prepared multi-page preview paths cache only matching viewport transform and dimensions

cases.expected: Stale scenes, wrong provenance and actual allocation admission failure retain usable scene ownership without orphaning prepared leases.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/prepared-ownership.test.ts:actual prepared consumer rejects stale scenes and wrong provenance without retaining a wire lease
node:apps/web/tests/prepared-ownership.test.ts:actual prepared allocation budget rejection retires output and leaves the scene usable

cases.expected: Injected page rejection/malformed data preserve previous pixels and paths; rejected release retains its handle through retry and disposal.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/prepared-ownership.test.ts:injected rejected and malformed prepared pages release leases and retain prior pixels and path owners
node:apps/web/tests/prepared-ownership.test.ts:injected prepared release rejection preserves ownership until retry and explicit consumer disposal

cases.expected: Injected response copy failure after an actual consumed release quarantines ownership without repeating the committed command.
testIds: node:apps/web/tests/prepared-quarantine.test.ts:injected copy failure after consumed prepared release quarantines without repeating the committed command
